phyogs 'dir skye bo'i tshogs rnams la longs spyod kyi bum bzang legs par byo nas/ so so'i 'dod pa thams cad yid bzhin du grub par mdzad nas/ thub pa'i dbang po'i sku jo tshad legs par grub ste/ bkra shis sgo mang gi mchod khang du bzhugs su gsol ba'i bar gyis/ dgongs rdzogs thams cad rin po che nyid kyis mthar 'don par mdzad pa yin no// de'i dus thams cad du me tog sngon po'i char chen pos sa'i khyon thams cad gang zhing rten ring bsrel byon tshul sogs ha cang yi ge mang bas 'jigs nas 'dir ma bkod do// nang rten gyi gser sku la me tog mthor dus su char dkon pa'i dus yin pa la char gyi rgyun chen po bab pas/ thub pa char 'bebs ma zhes grags shing*/ phyis kyang char dkon dus sku khrus gsol zhing char 'bab pa'i gsol ba btab na rtsol med du char 'bab pa'i byin rlabs can du grags so// de ltar mtshungs pa med pa'i bla ma sa gsum gyi mgon po ā nan+da rat+na'i mtshan 'dzin pa 'dis yongs 'dzin bsten pa rnams la ngo lkog dang zhal gdeng med par thams cad la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes las tha mal gyi thugs rtog skad cig kyang mi mnga' zhing*/ lhag par rigs dang chos kyi rnam grangs du ma nas bka' drin che ba'i bla ma dam pa/ chos kyi rje dbang rin po che chos kyi rgyal po de nyid la sangs rgyas kyi sa mthar thug chos kyi sku'i nges pa khyad par can gyi mos gus 'gyur ba med pa thob pa'i nyer len gyis rgyu ni nyid kyi gsang ba'i rnam thar las/ lha khang chen mor mjal bar phebs nas thugs sgam pa'i rnam pas thugs dam rin po che'i phreng ba ma gzigs par bsnams nas/ mtshe'u khar phebs pas srod dus thugs dam gyi rim par 'jug par nye ba na/ phyag phreng mgul du mi 'dug pas cung zad thugs 'phreng ba'i rnam pa zhig gis rkyen byas nas gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ gar song cha med du mi snang bar gyur pas/

de'i don brtag pa'i phyir phyi de'i nangs par zhabs drung byon pas sku 'dzum bag dang ldan pas glang po che'i gzigs stangs kyis gzigs nas/ thugs dam rin po che'i phreng ba ngom pa ltar mdzad kyin 'dug pas/ kho bo ni skyengs pa 'dra ba zhig gis rnam pas yid drangs nas/ snang grags kyi chos thams cad la 'di yin dang 'di min gyi rtsis gdab ma rnyed par/ yun ring po zhig tu lus pas/ de'i tshe rin po che nyid kyis gsung gi gnang ba dang thugs phreng gnang*/ zab cing rgya che ba spros te/ de'i nyin par nas rje nyid la mos gus ltem rkyang skad cig kyang 'char ma myong ba yin gsungs/ gsung de dag gi don ji ltar lags zhus pas/ deng sang snyigs ma'i dus 'dir de rnams kyi don bshad kyang khab mig tu ri'i rgyal po 'dren pa dang 'dra bar gang gis kyang blor tshud par mi 'gyur zhing*/ skur pa'i gnas su 'gyur dogs yod pas/ gal chung gsungs nas gnang du ma btub pa'i gnad cig 'dug pa don gyis go// des na mtshungs pa med pa'i bla ma dam pa 'dis 'gyur ba med pa'i dad gus kyi chu mtsho gting zab cing*/ ji ltar gsungs pa'i don thams cad mthar phyin pa'i rlabs kyi phreng ba la dbang sgyur ba yin pas/ yum drung rgyal mo ba'i drung la yang ji srid zhal bzhugs kyi bar du bkur sti chen po dang*/ sku'i dkyil 'khor nongs pa'i tshe dgongs rdzogs kyi bya ba thams cad lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi yid tshim par mdzad do// de nas tshogs gnyis kyi rgya mtsho rnam par spel ba'i phyir zad pa med pa'i longs spyod la dbang bsgyur bar bzhed pa'i tshul bstan nas gnod sbyin ye shes kyi mgon po la bka' bsgo bas/ bka' nyan gyi 'phrin las tshul bzhin bsgrub pa dang du blangs pas/ de'i lo nas longs spyod rnams rdzogs ldan gyi sprin bzhin du 'dus par gyur te/ lo re'i nang du yang rgya nag dang mnga' ris bal bod khams gsum nas/

che dgu dang btsun dgu skal ba dang ldan pa rnams dal 'byor don dang ldan zhing longs spyod la snying po len pa'i phyir/ phyogs phyogs nas ser sna'i lam las 'das shing longs spyod rnams rje 'di'i phyag du ci thengs la 'gran pa ltar gyur to// de dag gis tshul yang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bsdu ba bzhi la brten nas/ 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i tshul de nyid las gzhan du 'da' bar mi mdzad cing*/ ka ca'i dngos po chung ngu tsam yang chud zos dang rang don du spyod par mi mdzad pas/ rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa'i rnam par thar pa las mi 'da' bar 'brel tshad don dang ldan par mdzad pa ni rmad du byung ba'i rnam par thar ba'o// de ltar chu bo chen po'i rgyun ltar zad mi shes pa'i longs spyod la snying po len tshul yang sngar nas cung zad smos pa ltar lo re re bzhin gong ma'i dus mchod chen mo rnams dus las yol ba med par/ dge 'dun rnams la bsnyen bkur rgya chen po dang ldan pa'i rang gzhan la phan bde'i gzhi thengs par mdzad/ rten gsum rnams kyi drung du snyan dar mar me spos sogs kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i bye brag rnams legs par bkod/ skye bo'i tshogs la sbyin gtong gi rim pas rang rang gi yid tshim par mdzad cing*/ gzhan yang dbyar dgun gyi cha la dge 'dun grangs mang po dang ldan pas/ sher phyin rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum la brgya tshar gsum las mi nyung ba dang*/ bka' 'gyur rin po che tshar lnga re dang*/ bstan 'gyur tshar re sgrog par mdzad cing*/ ye shes mgon po sogs gsar rnying gi rkang gi rgyun 'dzin bcu las mi nyung ba dang*/ gsung rab kyi rgyun nyin mtshan thun bgos nas 'dzin pa grangs ldan dpyid dus su tsha tsha'i rim pa 'bum ther dang*/ mdo rgyud nas gsungs pa'i mdos kyi rim pa rnams dang*/ de'i dus kyi gsung rab sgrog pa rnams dang*/ spong ba'i brtul zhugs lo gsum phyogs gsum dang bcas pa'i lo gsum re'i dam bca' dang ldan pa grangs mang la 'tsho ba'i rim pa dang*/

'chad nyan la bskos pa'i bshes gnyen rnams dang*/ dbyar chos dgun chos sogs kyi cha rkyen rnams bla brang nas sbyor bar mdzad kyang de rnams la ngal ba dang dub pa mi mnga' zhing*/ longs spyod rnams phongs pa med par btang nas/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che yun ring du gnas pa'i phyir/ zhal bkod kyi khyab par mdzad cing*/ bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa'i rtsa lag tu 'gyur bar mdzad do// de rnams kyi don mdor bsdus tsam smras pa/ chos sku mnyam nyid ngang las ma g.yos par// gzugs sku sgyu ma'i gar gyis 'gro ba 'dren// rgyal ba'i spyan sngar dri med li tsa bī// 'phags yul rgyal ba'i zhal skyin klu sgrub mgon// rtsod dus gangs ri'i khrod 'dir rin chen dpal// ding sang 'di na kun dga' rin chen zhes// grags pa'i khur 'dzin sa gsum 'gran med 'dis// rgyal ba'i bstan la rgyal ba'i mdzad pa bstan// sems can mos pa'i khyad par sna tshogs la// zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po'i cho 'phrul gyis// skal par 'tsham pa'i bdud rtsis tshim par mdzad// 'jungs pa rnams kyi ser sna'i mdud pa bkrol// zhe sdang can rnams drag pos zil gyis mnan// nga rgyal can rnams khengs pa'i ri bo bsnyil// 'dod chags can rnams tshul khrims ra bar bcug /gti mug can la rgyu 'bras me long bstan// phrag dog can rnams mnyam nyid don la bkod// g.yo zhing snying po med pa'i longs spyod rnams// thabs mkhas thugs rjes tshogs gnyis gter du sbas// rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa'i skal bar mdzad// stong gsum mi mjed zhing gi dpal gcig po// rab 'byams bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mgon po 'di// zhing khams kun tu rnam 'phrul sna tshogs kyis// rdul phran re re'i steng du rgyal ba yi// longs sprul zhing khams rab 'byams snang bar mdzad// sems can bsam pa'i khyad par ji bzhin du// rnam par 'phrul pa'i de 'drar snang bar mdzad// rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams// sangs rgyas sras kyi dbus na bzhugs pa zhes// gsungs pa'i don yang 'di 'dra'i rnam 'phrul gyis// 'gro ba 'dren pa'i tshul la dgongs par nges// deng sang phyogs 'dir rnam 'phrul mdzad pa ni// kun mthun kun las lhag pa'i thugs rje yis// nyang kong sogs nas mi bsrun skye bo 'gas// log par sgrub pa'i tshul gyis rgol na yang*// ting 'dzin thugs rje'i ngang las ma g.yos par// tshar bcad rjes 'dzin dbang du bsdu bar mdzad// kun gyis bkur zhing bran ltar phrin las bsgrubs// longs spyod gang yod rje 'di'i phyag du btang*// 'di yang ngo mtshar bstan pa'i rgyan du che// zhes so// 'di ltar bdag cag gi bla ma khams gsum gyi mgon po/

dus gsum du gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyi rgyal tshab tu gyur pa/ skye dgu thams cad srid pa'i sdug bsngal las skyob par byed pa'i mkhyen brtse dang nus pa'i pha mthar byon pa 'dis/ tshogs gnyis rin po che'i chu gter gyi ngoms pa med pa'i brtul zhugs bzung nas/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi nyer 'tsho'i gzhir gyur pa/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyi gdung rgyud mi 'chad par bya ba'i phyir/ thugs bskyed rnam par dag pas kun nas blangs te/ thog mar bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' gangs ri'i khrod 'dir 'gyur ro cog rgyu bzang zhing 'bru dag la sdeb legs par bzhengs pa'i tshul/ rgyun chags zhes pa'i tshigs bcad kyi lam dang ring thung spel ba'i srad bu dri ma med pa la sbrengs te smras pa/ rnam dag gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs su bskor ba'i sa phyogs nyams dga' bkra shis rgyal bas bsngags pa'i byang chub gling mchog 'dir// rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab 'gro la kun nas dga' ba'i dpal ster rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan rtse mor mthon zhing legs gsungs dri ma med pa'i sprin phung bsdus nas bdud rtsi'i char rgyun 'bebs mdzad pa// dpal ldan bzang po'i mtshan dang dpe byad rab 'bar rgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i zlos gar sgyur mkhas gang yin des ni 'gro la kun nas rtse phyir rten gsum rin chen mchog /thog mar rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin chen rgyu bzang 'di ni dad can dag gis legs par phul ba'i longs spyod rnams ni gnas skabs mthar thug dag gis 'bras bzang 'grub phyir du// ma lus rgyal ba sras bcas lo paṇa skyes mchog rgyal blon byang sems brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la srid zhus gus pa'i bka' drin gsob phyir bzhengs pa'i dgongs pa deng 'dir shar// shar ba'i bka' bstsal spyi gtsug nor bus len pa'i gus ldan gtong ba'i blo mchog ser sna'i sgrib pa rnam par bral ba'i ngang tshul can// tshan po che yi stobs dang ldan zhing drag po'i shugs kyis phas rgol 'joms dang rang srid skyong mkhas pa// mgon po rgyal mtshan dpal ldan bzang po'i longs spyod dang ldan des ni khyu mchog nyid du mdzad de drung 'khor rags ma'i tshogs// sgyu rtsal 'gran zla med cing rje la gus pa'i sgo gsum thal mo legs sbyar ston zla lta bur mdzes pa'i bzhin las 'dzum gyi phreng ba rnam par 'phro// de dag kun kyang rang rang 'khor dang bcas te bka' bstsal sgrub la 'gran pa bzhin// gzhan du pho nya zho shas 'tsho ba rnams kyang yid la dga' ba'i chu gter gyis gang bzhin gyi pad+mo rnam par 'bus pa'i 'dzum mdangs dang bcas bya ba sgrub la ngal ba med// de ltar mthun par bgyis te sbyor dngos rjes gsum rnam par dkar bas thugs dam bzang po deng 'dir bsgrubs// mi mjed zhing gis sa yi thig le lho rgyal 'dzam bu tri shas mtshan pa'i gling mchog thub dbang mchog gis thugs bskyed dam pas bzung*// rgyal sras 'phags pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su gang zhing gzhan phan blo mchog mnga' bas skye dgu'i don la nyin mtshan g.yel med brtson rnams dang*// nyan rang 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams dang ni sna tshogs gdul bya lha klu gnod sbyin dri za'i tshogs dang 'gro mchog rnams la thar lam bstan// bstan pa'i snying po dar ba'i 'phags yul rdo rje gdan las byang du phyogs pa 'bri gung byang chub gling mchog rgyal ba'i bzhugs gnas 'di// sa 'dzin rnams ni ched du bkod pa lta bur lcags ri'i tshul gyis yongs bskor 'jigs pa'i dgra dang rnam par bral zhing bag phebs pa// dri ma med pa'i chu rgyun rnams ni dus kyi 'chus pa'i kha dog dang ldan yid 'ong lhung lhung sgra 'byin lbu phreng zur mig g.yo// smad zhol rkang 'thung lo 'dab me tog 'bras bus spud pa'i dga' ston dang ldan phan tshun yal ga'i khyon yangs rtse mor gnyis skyes tshogs// rab tu mdzes pa'i 'phur lding zlos gar bsgyur zhing mgrin pa'i rol mo 'khrol bas dri za'i tshogs kyi glu dang rol mo'i khengs pa 'phrog

/sa gtsang ri bo'i gzengs mtho mthil sdengs dang ni gshang gshong nyams dgas rnam par brgyan zhing ting 'dzin rtse gcig sgrub pa'i bsti gnas mchog /rgyal bas bsngags shing rgyun chad med par grub chen du mas dam pa'i chos kyi 'brug sgra snyan pas gdul bya'i tshogs la chos char 'bebs// yongs su smin cing grol ba'i lam bzang mchog gi sa lam ma lus skad cig re res bsgrod par mdzad cing sku bzhi'i 'bras bu smin// gzhan du lo grangs du mar bsgrubs pa'i sa sde btsugs la 'dir ni nyin zhag 'ga' tsam gus pa'i stobs kyis gnas pa don che zhes// 'jig rten gsum gyi bla ma de yi gsung las bslu ba med pa'i sgra dbyangs bsgrogs pas der gnas 'gro ba nyam nga'i g.yang las grol// zhing khams mchog 'dir nye ba'i sa phyogs mtshe'u kha bde ldan gtsug lag khang chen 'og min dang mtshungs gzhal med mchog gi khri steng du// chos phung brgyad khri'i brjod bya ma lus bslab gsum rim gnyis yan lag dang bcas ma nor tshul bzhin ston pa'i gsung rab rin chen gter// lug lo'i ston dus smin drug zla ba'i yar tshes bzang por rig byed mkhas pa'i mthar son yi ge'i 'du byed sgyur la zla bral ba// bzhi brgya'i tshogs bcas rin chen 'bur du dod par 'khod pa'i lto dkar mkhan po bkra shis grangs ldan dang ni spyod ldan zhu dag mkhas// glegs shing glegs thag na bza'i tshogs rnams rang rang bzo la sbyangs pa'i mthar phyin rnams kyi legs par bsgrubs te 'grub sbyor bzang po la// bslab gsum dri ma med cing rim gnyis mthar son rig sngags cho ga rgya mtsho'i don la dbang 'byor bshes gnyen brgya phrag du ma yis// rab gnas tshul bzhin mdzad pa'i mnga' dbul shis brjod phreng ba sprel zhing me tog 'thor ba'i gtso bo mtshungs med rgyal ba'i dbang pos mdzad// de tshe nam mkha'i khams kun mkha' spyod sa dang sa 'og la spyod dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma dang lha yi bu dang bu mos gang*// 'ja' dang 'od kyis nam mkha'i khams kun mdzes par byas shing me tog char ni lding zhing 'bab pas sa gzhi'i ngos kun khebs par gyur// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa kun tu bzang po'i sprin phung las byung snyan pa'i glu dang mdzes pa'i gar bsgyur lhab lhub gos ldan zhing*// sna tshogs rgyan gyis rnam par spud pa'i na chung bzang mo rnams ni me tog dri ngad ldan pa'i spos dang mar me dri chab thogs// gya nom ro brgya ldan pa'i zhal zas dang ni glu dang sbyar ba'i rol mor bcas te lha yul sa dang bar snang la gnas pa'i// yid rab 'phrog cing sna tshogs mchod pa'i bkod pas mdzes shing tshogs gnyis sprin phung las byung dri ma med pa'i mchod pas mchod par byas// yon gyis khyad par rnam thos bu yi 'byor pa zil mnan lha yi gos dang kha dog rnam par bkra ba'i dar gyi chun pos bar snang bkang*// 'gying ldan 'gros bzang rta dang glang po na gzhon la sogs rkang bzhi'i tshogs kyis bar mtshams med par sa yi khyon kun gang bar byas// gzhan du bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis gang ba'i gan dkar dang ni gser g.yu go khrab lha yi 'byor pas yid kyi shing rta gang bar mdzad// rig byed pa rnams rab tu dga' ba'i dpal thob rang rang rdzu la brten kyang 'dzum bu ma thub phan tshun blta zhing mdzes pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan// nyin dang mtshan du g.yel ba med par rje 'di'i bstod pa 'ba' zhig kha ton byed cing 'di phyi'i don kun bde blag 'grub par gyur// de ltar legs byas bye bas 'phags pa'i skye dgu rnams ni phyogs 'dir dal 'byor don dang ldan zhing longs spyod rnams kyi snying po'i don// de ltar bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang chen 'di// phyogs su gom pa gang bor rnam grol lam// tshe gcig nyid du thob 'gyur the tshom med// rten gsum rin chen 'di rnams bzhengs tshe yid// dang ba dang ni dad pa lhur blangs nas/

cung zad tsam gyis 'byor pa phul ba dang*// mthong thos dran dang reg par gyur pa 'am// chu len me 'bud thal 'chag la sogs pa// thams cad ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa dang bral zhing*// mngon par mtho dang nges legs 'bras bu thob// de phyir bdag cag ltos bcas thams cad kyang*// gnas skabs dbang gis bsam pa ci shar yang*// thams cad dge la bkod mdzad chos kyi rje// 'di 'dra'i mgon gyis rjes bzung skal pa bzang*// de phyir snying nas dad gus bskyed par gyis// zhes so// de lta bu'i bdag nyid chen po 'dis/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che bzhengs pa'i dgongs pa ni mthar phyin/ 'bri gung byang chub kyi gling du bshad sgrub kyi snying po len pa'i dge 'dun gyi tshogs pa rnams ni yid bzhin gyi rgya mtsho bzhin du dar zhing*/ brgya phrag re re dang gnyis gnyis kyis gang ba dang bri ba ni mi mngon/ so so'i yongs 'dzin chen po rnams kyis phyogs mtha' dag dge 'dun gyi bya ba 'khor lo rin po che rnam pa gsum gyis dus 'da' bar byed pa'i dgongs pa ni bsgrubs/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po nas deng sang gi bar du/ bye brag gis gdul byar gyur pa'i 'dan yul sogs nas/ rje nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad pa brtan po thob cing*/ yon tan du ma'i khur gyis lji ba'i bshes gnyen chen po puṇ+ya sa mu dras thog drangs khams skyo'i bla ma chen po khu dbon rnams dang*/ bkra shis sgang pa'i bla ma chen po khu dbon 'ja' mo dbon po dang bcas pa'i che dgu rnams kyis phrin las kyi rtsa ba bzung ste/ 'bul dpon rnams la rim pa bzhin du/ rta dang dre'u gser dngul sogs longs spyod rnams kyis 'bul ba rgyun mi 'chad cing*/ khyad par rgya nag nas/ gong ma rgyal po'i gnang sbyin rnams kyang je bzang je bzang du gyur cing*/ 'bul dpon rnams kyis kyang ji lta ba bzhin phyag du 'byor/ mnga' ris bskor gsum nas kyang*/

gu ge'i rgyal po sogs so so'i sa skyong che chung dgon sde grwa bu slob dang bcas pa rnams kyis kyang so so nas 'bul ba'i bye brag bgrang ba las 'das pa rnams dang*/ dbus gtsang gi che dgu phal cher gyi rje btsun 'di'i zhabs pad la spyi gtsug gis nor bus btud te lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na 'gran zla dang bral zhing rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab tu gyur pas de dag gis phul ba'i longs spyod rnams chud mi za ba dang*/ 'gro kun rnam grol gyi lam la 'god pa'i phyir/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab la rgyal ba nyid dang mtshungs pa'i zab pa dang rgya che ba'i don rnams la thogs pa med pa'i blo gros kyis phyin ci ma log par gsal bar zab mo'i don rnam par 'byed nus pa'i dam pa rnams kyi bstan bcos/ lo paṇa chen po rnams kyi ji snyed 'gyur ba rnams ni/ rgyal ba'i gsung gi gru bo che la brten nas 'gro kun thar pa'i gling du sgrod par mdzad pa'i ded dpon nam/ shes bya'i gnas thams cad mngon sum du blta bar byed pa'i mig dang mtshungs par gzigs nas/ 'di dag 'bru dag par glegs bam dkar po'i phreng bar spel ba sngon chad bod 'dir mang zhig byung 'dug na'ang*/ glegs bam sngon po'i ngos la rin po che'i yig 'brus bkod pa mi 'dug pas/ nyid kyis rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa la sngon chad ma byung ba'i bkur sti chen pos bsnyen bkur ba dang*/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che la bya ba rlabs po che mdzad pa'i sgo nas mtha' yas pa'i skye dgu rnams skyob pa'i slad du/ rgyu rin po che las grub pa'i thugs dam bstan 'gyur/ bka' brgyud gong ma'i bka' 'bum ltos che ba dang bcas pa/ glegs bam sngon po'i phreng ba bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan 'di spel bar bzhed nas/ thog mar ma phyi 'dzam gling chos kyi rgyal po'i thugs dam bstan 'gyur las zhus shing*/ dag pa'i chu rgyun gyis byi dor mdzad/

cung zad kha 'thor rnams legs par bsdus te tshang bar mdzad nas/ sde tshan so so'i bzhugs tshul go rim rnams/ mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa rnams kyis bzhed pa'i dkar chag gzhir bzhag ste/ gzhan dag ni re zhig ngal gso'i gnas su mdzad do// de dag gi don tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ mkha' lding rgyal po bya lo shar ba'i tshe// 'phan zhogs rig pa'i gnas nas legs 'ongs pa'i// bris mkhan mkhas rnams mkhas pas legs par brtags// rtsod med mkhas pa'i tshogs rnams phyogs 'dir bsdus// gza' skar sbyor byed phun sum tshogs pa la// dbu 'dzugs mdzad de lo bzhi'i nang la grub// zhu dag gsung rab don la legs sbyangs shing*// sgra dang tshad ma'i dpal 'byor du mas phyug /'bri gung byang chub gling na bzhugs pa yi// skyes chen du mas zhus shing dag par mdzad// po ti gnyis gnyis dril ba'i phreng ba ni// brgya dang brgyad du legs par spel ba'i tshe// lo thog phun tshogs nad dang mu ge bral// 'ja' 'od gur dang me tog char rnams kyis// rgyun tu nam mkha'i ngos kun mdzes par byas// yongs su rdzogs par bsgrub phyir byi ba'i lo// cho 'phrul chen po rta yi zla ba la// smyu gu 'dzugs par rtsom pa'i dus kyi tshe// dbyar dus phyogs 'dis ring par 'ongs nas ni// ngo mtshar blta zhing mchod phyir chas pa bzhin// rtswa sngo lo 'dab dus las yol ba yang*// shing rnams me tog phreng ba'i do shal 'phyang*// rig byed pa rnams ya mtshan mig bsgrad nas// bden nam brdzun zhes brtags pa'i lam la bzhugs// legs par rtogs nas dad pa'i mig bu rnyed// ngo mtshar don la yengs pa med par blta// zas skom yon la sred pa chung bar gyur// nyin mtshan g.yel med brtson pa'i go cha bgos// ring por ma thogs dgongs pa legs par grub// de nas dus bzang gza' skar 'dzom pa la// sngags 'chang grub pa brnyes pa'i skyes bu mchog

/dpal ldan zla ba'i 'od kyis mtshan 'chang bas// rab gnas mnga' dbul mtshan nyid tshang bar mdzad// glegs shing glegs thag na bza'i tshogs dang bcas// rin chen khri la bzhugs su gsol nas ni// shis brjod me tog 'thor ba'i gral dbu la// mtshungs med kun dga'i nyi ma bzhugs par mdzad// yon tan khur gyis lci ba'i che bgres kyi// thog drangs dge 'dun rnams kyi g.yas gral mdzad// rig byed mkhas pa'i rgyan 'chang tog dkar bas// thog drangs bris mkhan rnams kyis g.yon gral mdzad// bza' btung bkur sti'i khri la blangs pa'i steng*// yon gyi khyad par rnam par bkram pa ni// bar snang gos dang dar gyis mdzes par byas// sa gzhi'i ngos kun go dang khrab kyis chod// bar mtshams thams cad gser g.yu zangs kyi gtams// phan tshun lung pa rta dang nor gyis bkang*// shis brjod snyan pa'i phreng ba sbrengs nas ni// me tog chun po 'thor ba'i dus kyi tshe// mkha' la me tog char ni cher babs shing*// phyogs kun 'ja' dang 'od kyis gang bar gyur// de tshe rig byed pa rnams phan tshun du// zur mig blta zhing 'di ltar sems zhes grags// 'di ci rmi lam ngo mtshar ram// 'on te mngon sum yin nam zhes// sems shing nges pa thob pa'i tshe// bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor 'dzum gyi phreng bas gung*// lag pa'i pad dkar sor mo'i 'dab phreng can// spyi bor zlum zhing bstod pa'i sprin phung las// dad ba'i char rgyun ci yang bab par gyur// gus pa'i lha phyag mang du 'tshal nas ni// rang rang 'dod pa'i gnas su kha lo sgyur// 'di yi rgyu shog 'phral gyis longs spyod rnams// yi ge'i 'du byed sgyur bar gang gis nus// mdor na snga phyir yon rdzongs song ba'i tshul// cung zad kho bos mthong tshul 'di ltar yin// rta mchog dul zhing 'gying ba 'gros bzang dang*// spu sdug khur bzang chen por 'os pa yis// dre'u dang bcas bzhi brgya lhag tsam song*/

khyung dkar mdzo dang mdzo mo'i tshogs rnams dang*// mdor na rkang bzhi'i tshogs kyang grangs las 'das// gan gos lha yi gos la 'gran nus pa// bzo yug du ma dang bcas gan dar sogs// dkar spyad la sogs khyad nor gnang sbyin rnams// re re'i ming nas bgrang bar mi nus so// 'di yi zhal lta bkod pa'i khyad par dang*// thugs khur thams cad mthil du blangs nas ni// zhabs 'bring sgrub par byed pa'i skyes bu ni// 'bri gung bstan pa rin chen 'dzin pa'i phyir// bos pa'i 'gron bzhir grags pa'i ya gyal mchog /rwa sgreng mthu chen zhes bya'i gdung rigs las// legs par 'ongs shing thugs las 'khrungs pa'i sras// smon lam mang pos sngon nas legs btud cing*// dpa' zhing brtul phod blo gros mchog ldan pa// mgon po rgyal mtshan legs pa'i dpal 'dzin gang*// spobs pa bzang po can des gus par bsgrubs// rgyal bas bsngags pa'i 'dzam gling byang phyogs 'dir// rgyal ba gnyis pa 'jig rten gsum mgon gyi// zhabs kyis bcags shing byin gyis brlabs pa'i sa// drang srong 'jigs med bsam gtan mdzad pa'i gnas// sgo mang gser gyi mchod sdong 'gying ba'i zhol// rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen dpal bzang po// rgyun tu chos 'khor skor zhing bzhugs pa'i gnas// chos 'dod skal ldan tshogs rnams 'du ba'i zhing*// rin chen bskyed mos tshal gyi mtsho 'gram du// dri med nor bu'i ljon shing phreng ba can// 'khril shing shel gyi lcug phran gzhon nus 'khyud// sna tshogs me tog rnams ni rnam par bkra// yid 'ong bung ba'i tshogs rnams 'phur zhing lding*// spu sdug ri dwags tshogs rnams rgyug cing mchong*// myos pa'i khu byug zab mo'i gling bu sgyur// yid 'ong bye'u mgrin pa'i pi waṃ sgrog /rin chen bai ḍūr sngon po'i dbus mtho bar// lha phrug gzhon nu me tog 'thor ba'i gnas// mtshe'u kha bde ldan gtsug lag khang chen du// rje 'dis bzhengs pa'i bka' 'gyur rin chen dang*// thugs dam rten gsum mang du grub pa'ang bzhugs// khyad par phyogs 'dir sngon chad ma byung pa'i// bstan 'gyur rin chen bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan 'di// phyogs 'dir rin chen bum bzang byos pa 'am// phyogs bcu'i yid bzhin nor bu ma lus pa// zhing 'dis bsdus te gcig tu spungs pa bzhin// gzims khang mtshe'u kha'i rgyal mtshan rtse mor btags// grub gnyis 'dod dgu'i char rgyun ci yang 'bebs// rgyal ba rgya mtsho dgyes pa'i mchod sprin dang*// rnam mang 'gro la tshogs gnyis spel ba'i phyir// mtshungs med rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyis// rin chen rin thang med par btsal zin gyis// lha klu gnod sbyin dri za'i tshogs rnams dang*// 'byor ldan 'gro mchog chos la spyod 'dod rnams// rang rang rtse dgas bstod cing mchod par rigs/

blo gros gsal zhing nges par 'byung 'dod rnams// nyan bshad klog dang sems shing sgom pa sogs// chos spyod rnam bcu 'phel ba'i gzhir mdzod cig /gzhan yang phyag dang skor ba la sogs kyis// dal 'byor rin chen snying po len par mdzod// zhar byung tsam du 'gro dang 'ong ba rnams// gus pa'i yid kyi 'dud na'ang don chen 'grub// 'di yi las gnyer khur 'dzin thams cad dang*// 'di phyir sgyu lus cung zad bkol ba dang*// zas nor longs spyod 'brel ba gang yod dang*// mthong thos dran reg yi rang bgyid rnams las// dus kyi dbang gis khro 'am dad byed pa// de dag dam pa'i mgon gyis rjes bzung bas// 'jigs rung srid pa'i mtsho las rab sgrol te// thar pa'i lam sna zin par the tshom med// dga' bar bgyis la snying nas gsol ba thob// ces so// bar skabs zhig nas skye dgu rnams skal ba dman pa'i dbang gis/ rgyal khams su 'khrug pa chen po langs pa'i gzhi phal cher sne gdong pa dang*/ rin spungs pa ma 'dum pa'i dbang gis byi ba'i lo la sde gzar chen po langs pas skye bo mang po kha dag par byas te/ de'i dus sne gdong pa cung zad spangs mtho ba ltar snang ba'i thugs rgyal gyi snyems pas/ rgyal khams thams cad mnga' 'bangs su 'jug pa dang*/ khyad par 'bri gdan gyi dam tshig gnyan po la yang 'gongs nas thub spyod chen pos nyes pa yod med kyi brtag gzhig med par 'bri gung pa'i sde la 'phral du tsha rngam chen pos dpung gi tshogs 'jigs 'jigs ltar snang ba bkod nas 'jun sdur la zhugs so// de'i tshe yang rin po che 'di thugs 'khrug pa med cing*/ cung zad brtag gzhig gi lam la 'jug pa'i dgongs pas/ rang gi mnga' 'og gang yod kyi rang srung tsam du bsdu bar mdzad de/ dbu ru ka tshal gyi gtsug lag khang du phebs nas/ lugs gnyis kyi sgo nas 'bri gdan 'brel chags tshul nas da lta yang nyes pa'i zhad med pa'i rnam bzhag rnams gsung drang po'i gnang ba bstan nas brda legs par 'byor ba rnams kyis sbran kyang*/

da res kyi dpung 'gyes bde ba tsam las gzhan pa'i rtsi bzhag med par gyis so// de'i 'og tu rin po che yang slar mtshe'u khar phebs nas/ thugs mi g.yo ba mnyam pa nyid lhun gyis grub pa'i don la mnyam par bzhag ste/ rig byed pa rnams bsdus nas/ thugs dam bstan 'gyur rin po che mthar 'don pa'i dgongs pa mdzad do// de'i dus su yang yar lung pa'i gser yig pa rnams kyis mi rigs pa'i gtam mang po gtang*/ dkyus ma rnams kyi khra chen du 'dug pa thos nas/ drung 'khor rnams kyi mthar byed kyi lto bar rdzong ba'i gros byas pa gsan te/ thugs brtse ba chen pos mi 'jigs pa gnang nas rang gnas su bde bar phyin par mdzad do// de ga'i 'phral du smyug gu btsugs pas/ blo chung rnams sne gdong pa'i gser yig gi rgyab dmag dpung gi mnan nas yong gin 'dug pas/ chos rje'i thugs dam bstan 'gyur rang ci 'dra 'am zhes ma rangs pa'i tshul gyi gleng ba la der thugs mnyam par bzhag pas/ a phyi chos kyi sgron ma yum drung rgyal mo'i chas su mdzad nas/ skyon mi yong ba'i gsung gis gnang ba byung nas thugs brling bar mdzad de legs par bsgrubs shing mthar phyin nas/ bzo rig pa rnams rang gnas su phyin pa'i skabs su/ sne gdong pa'i dpung chen po bteg ste/ skyid g.yor 'phan gsum gyi dmag dpon dga' ldan pas byas/ de bzhin du yar lung lho byang 'ol kha ba dang bcas shing*/ stag lung pa dang stag rtse pa sogs so so nas dpung gi tshogs chen po bshams nas thams cad kyang dregs pa'i khur chen pos non te/ shin tu rngam zhing g.yo la 'jigs 'jigs ltar snang ba char mun chen po 'thibs pa ltar nye bar btud par gyur to// dus der rin po che thugs g.yo ba dang 'khrug pa med par byams pa chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs/ bka'i gros la dbang ba rnams kyi thog drangs nas dpung gang yod rnams dbu ru ka tshal du bsu ba ltar du bkod nas/

gung dkar sne gdong pas bzung ba yang de ma thag tu blangs nas snying stobs chen pos brgal shing brnyas thabs kyi glo bsgyings so// de'i 'phral du dga' ldan pa sde ris dang bcas pas byang drangs nas thams cad dpung gis rlom pa chen po mgo bsgyur zhing se gol gtogs te/ go cha sra ba rnams ni rim pa ma 'chol bar bgos shing*/ skya mi dang rkang thang rnams rang rang rgyan dang dar cha rol mo'i bye brag rnams ni bkram/ mtshon cha'i bye brag rnams bzas shing*/ char sprin nag po 'am mun bsros pa bzhin du sa'i phyogs thams cad khyab par byas nas/ 'brug sgra drag po dang bcas pa'i ser bu 'bab pa'am/ smig ma'i nags tshal chen po mes tshig pa ltar 'jigs su rung ba'i sgra drag po dang bcas te lhags pas/ dgung dkar dang ka tshal gyi phyogs mtshams thams cad 'khor mor skor ba'i dus der/ tshu rol gyi dpung rnams nyung yang dpa' zhum par ma gyur pas tshan po che'i shugs kyi g.yul bsres so// de nas phan tshun dpa' bo rnams// lus bzang go cha'i rgyan dang bcas// sprin dkar bzhin du rab g.yo zhing*// mtshon chas mdzes pa'i lag pa rnams// glog phran bzhin du 'khyug par gyur// phan tshun mtshon 'debs phye mar lhags// go cha phal cher ral zhing grugs// mda' rdo rnams ni ser ba bzhin// la la glang chen lta bur 'gying*// rngul gyi dri dang khrag gi dri// phyogs mtshams kun tu bkram pa bzhin// sdar ma rnams ni glo snying 'dar// de ga'i mod la phyogs mtshams nas// rlung dmar drag po langs nas ni// sa dang bar snang 'byar ba bzhin// 'thor rlung drag pos gtor ba yi// sprin gyi phreng ba ji bzhin du// pha rol dpung tshogs byer bar gyur// nyi ma nub ri'i mal gdan bzung*// pha rol g.yul phur dpa' bo rnams// phal cher mthar byed lto bar song*// 'bri gung pa yi dpung tshogs la// nyes pa'i skyon gyi ma gos par// rmas pa tsam yang med par gyur// de yi zhag gcig gong rol du// rin chen chos rjes 'di skad gsung*// bdag gi chos skyong sgrub skul byas// bdud rtsi khol dang rmi ltas bzang*// da nang nam gyi tho rangs kyi// mngon sum du ni 'di ltar mthong*// a phyi chos kyi sgron ma ni// chu rta sngon po chibs su mdzad// sku la rgod kyi thul pa gsol// rngam zhing g.yo ba'i cha byad mdzad// mkha' 'gro chos skyong 'bum gyis bskor// nub kyi phyogs su rings par thal// bdag cag rnams ni rgyal mod kyang*// 'khrug pa'i dmag dpung snying re rje// zhes gsungs de yang mngon du gyur// de yi mod la dpung gi tshogs// so so'i gnas su gyes par gyur// nus pa'i dbang phyug chos rje 'di// slob dpon pad+ma'i gsung sprul zhes// rig 'dzin pad+ma gling pas gsung*// de yi lung bstan 'di ltar byung*/

zhang tshan 'khrugs pas dbus gtsang sil bur gtong : mi mthun sde la gnod pa sna tshogs 'byung : snang mdzad mi g.yo rab tu brtan par gnas: de ni 'bri gung spyan snga bcu gsum pa: zhes pa'i lung bstan mngon sum gyur// de nas bzung ste lo 'ga'i bar// gang du g.yul chen sres na yang*// de las gzhan du g.yo ma nus// bar bar dag tu 'ol kha ba// stag gsher bcas pas zhabs 'dren bsgrubs// de 'dra'i dus su blon chen 'gas// rje la 'di skad gsol ba btab// mkhyen brtse nus ldan khyod lta bus// bdud dpung tshar bcad ma byas na// sangs rgyas bstan pa ji ltar 'dzin// zhus tshe dam pa 'di nyid kyis// phrin las bzhi la mnyam par bzhag /de ga'i 'phral du 'ol kha ba// stag gsher bcas te brgal du byung*// de tshe 'bri gung pa yi dpung*// myur ba myur bar phyogs der bteg /de ga'i tsha rngam ma bzod par// pha rol dpung rnams zhum nas ni// ci byed gtol yang med bzhin du// thal sbyar lus ni btud nas su// bka' nyan sgrub pa'i khas len byas// che dgu drag dgu bsdus nas ni// phyag phyir khrid nas dbang du bsdus// 'di rnams kun gyi gros dang ni// rkyen khur ma lus thams cad kyang*// rje 'di'i dgongs pa sgrub pa la// blon po rin chen lta bu yi// dpa' zhing ngal med brtul phod pa// mgon po rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos// sde srid bzung ste bsgrubs pa yin// rje 'dis mdzad tshul 'di lta ste// pha rol sems ni rmugs pa dang*// yan lag rengs pa'i sbyor ba dang*// lus ni phyogs 'dir 'gugs par mdzad// bsgral ba'i las ni ma mdzad pas// kun la gnod pa med par gyur// zhes so// gzhan yang dam pa 'dis thugs bskyed dang gtong phod zhal bkod kyi khyad par re res kyang skye dgu thams cad kyi nyer 'tsho'i gzhi chen por gyur par mdzad pa'i tshul ni glang gi lo la lcam dang*/

stag gi lo la gcan po rnam par rgyal ba'i mtshan can sku'i dkyil 'khor dag pa'i dbyings su gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs kyi bye brag sgrub pa'i cha rkyen rnams phangs pa med par gnang ba dang*/ zhal ta bkod pa'i khyad par gyis so so'i dgongs pa dbyings su rdzogs par mdzad cing*/ de dag gi don rnams smon lam rgya mtshos spel ba'i phyir/ jo gdan chos lung pa'i mkhan po dge 'dun gyi tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs zhing bsnyen bkur rgya chen pos bsnyen bkur bar mdzad pa sogs brir ma lang ngo*// spre'u yi lo la yum chen mo'i drung chos kyi dbyings su thim pa'i dgongs rdzogs kyi bye brag sa chen po 'di'i steng du 'gran pa'i zla thams cad dang bral bar mdzad cing*/ smon lam rgya mtsho'i don la dbang bsgyur ba'i phyir/ stag lung pa'i chos rje rnam rgyal grags pa'i mtshan can spyan drangs nas/ zhabs tog dang zhabs rim bsnyen bkur rgya chen po'i 'bul snod kyi khyad par rnams kyang bgrang ba las 'das pa mdzad cing*/ 'bri stag gi sde ris kyang chos bzhin du skyong ba dang*/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyis bka' lung kyang bgro bar mdzad do// de ga'i phyi ma bya'i lo la gcung po chos kyi rgyal po sprul pa'i gnas su thim pa'i dgongs rdzogs thams cad nyid kyi bsgrubs pa'i tshul/ phyogs kyi dge 'dun rnams la mang skol/ 'bri gung du ser sogs dang 'gyed chen/ spyan snga rin po che'i thog drangs dbus gtsang gi bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la ji ltar 'os 'os su rnam gzhag mdzad pa rnams bgrang ba las 'das pa'o// de tsam gyi rkyen khur bab kyang thugs ngal ba dang skyo ba'i rnam pa spangs te thos bsam sgom gsum sogs chos spyod kyi rim pas dus 'da' bar mdzad cing bstan pa'i bya ba kho nas thams cad kyang dgongs pa rdzogs par mdzad do// gzhan yang rin po che 'dis dge ba'i bshes gnyen la blta ba dang*/

phyag bya ba dang*/ bsnyen bkur ba la ngoms pa med pa'i brtul zhugs rnam par dag pas skye dgu thams cad kyi mig rkyen du mdzad pa'i phyir yos kyi lo la spyan snga rin po che'i drung sku nyid nas kyang byon pa dang yun ring du zhal mjal ba yang ma grub pas thugs yus te/ bde chen yangs pa can gyi phyogs su sgar chen 'degs par mdzad pa'i bar lam du stag lung pa'i sku mched khu dbon dge 'dun gyis tshogs pa dang bcas pas bsnyen bkur gyi bye brag dpag tu med pa mdzad nas/ shul lam la thogs pa med par phebs te/ gza' skar sbyor byed bzang po la mjal ba'i zhu 'phrod kyis sbran cing rim pa ltar phebs pas/ dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur chen pos ja 'dren dang thab 'dzin stag lung nas nye bar bzung ste sa tshigs thams cad du bsnyen bkur dang bsu ba rgyun ma chad par mdzad/ khyad par mjal ba'i nyin par nyid kyi dbon po rdor rgyal bas thog drangs bla ma dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma dang bcas pa'i drung 'khor che dgu rnams dang*/ gdan sa mthil pa'i che bgres yon tan gyi khur gyis lci ba mang po dang*/ 'phyong rgyas stag rtse ba'i nang so rin chen rgyal mchog pas thog drangs sne gdong pa'i drung 'khor phal mo ches dmar sgar nas bsu ba dang thab 'dzin mdzad nas/ rim pa ltar phebs pas/ yangs pa can gyi dge 'dun rgya mtsho lta bus ser sbrengs dar cha rol mo'i tshogs kyi nam mkha' dang sa gzhi bar snang thams cad gang bar gyur cing*/ spyan snga rin po che'i drung nas kyang bsu ba mdzad pa'i sgo nas dpon slob kyang phyag dang phyag len mdzad pa'i skabs su me tog gi char chen po yang bab zhes thos so// de'i dus dpon slob gnyis gcig la gcig phyag nas 'ju zhing zab mo'i gsung gleng mdzad cing*/ rin po che'i khri bkod pa mchog ldan gyi steng du bzhugs shing*/ legs bcas du mas 'phangs pa'i drung 'khor rnams kyang phan tshun du snyan pa'i gsung gis gleng langs dang phan tshun byams pa'i blta bas blta zhing gcig la gcig yid rab tu dang bar ni gyur/

lha dang mi'i zas sna dang btung ba'i bye brag bkur sti'i khri la blangs pa rnams kyis sems mgu zhing yun ring po la yang yun thung ba'i 'dun pas kun nas dga' bar byed do/ dus der dam pa 'dis chos kyi rje spyan snga rin po che'i drung du brgya 'bul dang stong 'bul/ drung 'khor rnams la yang gya nom pa'i gnang sbyin/ de nas rin po che 'di nyid thang du sgar chen mdzad nas/ yangs pa can gyi dge 'dun rnams la mang skol dang ja gos dar dang rta dang khrab sogs 'gyed sna mang du mdzad pas/ thams cad thugs dgyes par gyur to// gnam khog tu gnas pa'i skye dgu thams cad gsung gi bdud rtsis tshim par mdzad de/ dam pa 'dis spyan snga rin po che'i drung du dbang khrid kyi khyad par yang gsan zhing dogs pa'i gnas cung zad yod pa rnams zhu len gyis gtan la phab nas sgro 'dogs kyi mtha' thams cad gcod pa'i tshul bstan nas/ thugs bag legs par phab te nyi ma re bzhin yang bzhugs gdan mnyam por mdzad cing*/ chos 'jig rten gyi gsung gleng dgos pa rnams kyang 'phral 'phral thugs thag chod par mdzad/ gzhi de nyid du/ gzhis kha rin chen dpungs pa'i ja 'dren 'bul snod kyi khyad par bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ phyogs der gnas pa'i skye bo rnams kyis kyang 'bul ba dang zhabs tog rang rang gis rdzas kyi sum gnyis phyag tu btang nas thar pa'i lam sna zin par gyur zhes pa'i snyan grags kyi ba dan phyogs thams cad du gsal bar gyur to// de ltar dpon slob phan tshun thugs yid gcig tu 'dres par gyur cing*/ dgongs pa'i don thams cad ji ltar bzhed pa bzhin du grub ste slar yang gdan sa chen por kha lo bsgyur ba'i gsol ba btab pas/ gnang sbyin rgya chen pos bskur sti dang ldan par mdzad/ drung 'khor rnams la yang bab thob dang mthun pa'i gnang sbyin gyis yid la dga' ba bskyed par mdzad de/ bra bo dang rong po sogs kyi gdan 'dren dang bstun nas byang phyogs su chibs kha sgyur bar mdzad pa'i thog mar bra rong rnams kyis 'bul ba zhabs tog bskur sti phun sum tshogs pa'i khri la blangs te rang rang gi longs spyod rnams don yod par bya ba'i phyir skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed chos kyi 'brel pa rnams zhus nas/

rgyun mi 'chad par bsngo ba dang smon lam gyis rgyas 'debs par mdzad do// de dag dang rjes su 'brel bar byang rigs kyi ru ba rnams rkyen 'ga' zhig la brten nas phyogs gcig tu 'dus par gyur te/ nan tan chen pos gdan 'dren zhus pas/ de dag gis zhu ba dang du blangs nas 'gro ba'i don phun sum tshogs pa mdzad pa'i phyir/ rim pa ltar phebs nas de rnams yang skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed yig drug la sogs pa'i lam rnam par dag pa la 'god par mdzad cing so so nas rta dang dre'u mar thud dang rkang bzhi'i bye brag gis lung pa'i phyogs thams cad bkang ste phul ba rnams bzhes shing*/ thams cad kyang bsngo ba smon lam gyis rgyas gdab ste tshogs gnyis kyi rgya mtsho chen por spel bar mdzad de/ so so'i sde ris ma 'dum pa rnams kyang sdum pa dang 'khon med par thams cad mthun pa'i lam la bkod de gdan sa chen por phebs nas/ bshad sgrub kyi bya ba brlabs po che rgyun mi 'chad cing rim gnyis kyi thugs dam zab mos dus 'da' bar mdzad do// de'i bar skabs zhig tu yar rgyab dpon chen pa la yang sne gdong gong mas dogs pa chen po'i gzhi yod pa'i steng du de'i snyad 'dogs kyang rnyed nas/ khrims gtam chen po bsgrags shing mthar rgyas su re zhig ngal so byin pa'i 'og tu gshed ma bskos pa'i gtam thos nas shin tu skrag pas bzhin gyis mdangs med par rtab rtab pos 'dir thal byung ba la/ chen po la 'os pa'i sne len dang*/ gsung gi snang ba zab cing rgya che la gsal bas dbugs dbyung bar mdzad cing dpon g.yog thams cad la mthun rkyen bsam gyis mi khyab pas lo ngo gnyis kyis bar du mtshe'u kha bde ldan gyi gtsug lag khang du phyag phyir 'jog pa mdzad pa'i steng du/ gzhis ka rin dpungs pas kyang phebs zhu ba byung ba dang*/ khong rang gi 'dod pa dang bstun nas chibs drel sogs bzang mang sgar chas dang bcas shing zhal bkod kyi khyad par lugs gnyis la phan pa'i gsung gis gnang ba bstan nas/

skyel ma bzang po dang bcas te nyan med kyi sar skyel bar mdzad de/ 'di yang rmad du byung ba'i mdzad pa'o// gzhan yang dam pa 'dis bstan bcos mdzad pa'i rim pa cung zad tsam zhig 'dir smos pa skabs su babs pa thog mar mos gus srog gi 'khor lo'i man ngag mi gsal bar bla ma la ltos dgos pa rnams legs par bkrol nas gsal bar byed pa'i khrid rim mdzad/ de dang 'brel bar lnga ldan rin po che'i gsal byed dang*/ khams nas nyid kyi sras kyi thu bo puṇ+ya sa mu dras zhus pa'i lan/ dgongs pa gcig pa'i dka' ba'i gnad rnams gsal bar byed pa'i dris lan 'od stong ldan pa dang*/ ri bo che pa'i sgom chen bsod nams grub kyis phyi nang gi khyad par dang*/ theg pa che chung gi khyad par/ sngags mtshan nyid kyi khyad par bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim gyi khyad par sogs zhib tu phye ba zhus pa'i lan/ lung rig man ngag sgrub yig gi gnad du mas brgyan pa dang*/ stag lung pa'i sgom chen rgyal mtshan bzang pos zhus pa'i lan/ gegs sel bogs 'don gyi gnad dang khyad par du yang thig le'i gegs sel gyi gnad dang bcas pa mdzad/ phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid yig dang*/ de'i rgyab skyor rnal 'byor bzhi'i rim pa tshigs su bcad pa mdzad/ khams skyo'i bla ma rnam gnyis kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ chos drug 'chad thabs kyi man ngag sbas don kun gsal mdzad/ gling kha dar rgyas rtser bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyis nyid kyi thugs dam du bzhes shing*/ yab mes rnams kyis kyang de la mnga' brnyes pa'i yi dam gyi rtsa ba gcig dgos zhus pa'i ngor/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub dkyil dngos grub kyi 'dod 'jo mdzad/ bde mgon gyi las rim gsal ba'i sgron me bya ba phyi rabs la phan pa'i don du mdzad/ a phyi chos kyi sgrol ma mched lnga'i sgrub thabs nor bu bsam 'phel zhes bya ba gdung rabs rnams phrin las la mnga' brnyes pa'i don du mdzad/

phyag chen chos drug gi gsol 'debs rigs bdag ma sgrub sde'i rtogs ldan rnams kyi bskul ba'i ngor mdzad/ nyid kyi gsang ba dang shin tu gsang ba'i rnam thar nang so rgya mtsho bas bskul ba'i ngor mdzad pa sogs mgo smos pa tsam mo// rgyas par blta bar 'dod na de dang de dag gi rim pa phyogs gcig tu sdebs pa las shes par bya'o// gzhan yang*/ lha dang bla ma mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams dang dus rtag tu 'bral ba med pa yin mod kyi/ 'on kyang tshu rol mthong ba'i ngor cung zad tsam cig rje nyid kyi gsang ba dang shin tu gsang ba'i rnam thar dang mthun par tshigs su bcad te smras pa/ gzhon nu'i dus nas dam can rdor legs kyis// stag lung pa yi dpung tshogs pham byas nas// da dung bdag gis dgra bo bsgral lags sam// zhus tshe thugs rje'i dbang gis 'di skad du// da ni ma bsgral rang gar zhog cig gsung*// thugs rje'i gter chen mnga' ba khyod la 'dud// des kyang rje 'di 'jig rten gsum mgon nyid// slar yang phyogs 'dir byon pa the tshom med// 'bri gung mthil du dgun khrid thon pa'i rjes// thog kha gser khang bla ma'i gzims khang gis// gzhal yas khang du bka' brgyud ma lus gzigs// de yi nang nas mnyam med dwags po yis// rin chen mu tig snod chen bkang nas gnang*// 'di ni khyod kyi grwa pa'i grangs yin gsung*// bla ma'i lung bstan thob la phyag 'tshal lo// de yi phyi lo ras phud thon rjes su// 'bri gung thang sogs sa dang bar snang rnams// zhun mar dang bcas ras dkar sdong bu can// rin chen kong bu'i tshogs kyis legs par gtams// nyid kyi gcig sgron thams cad 'bar bar gzigs// shes rab sgron mes sa gsum gsal ba'i rtags// 'od gsal mngon gyur khyed la phyag 'tshal lo// sgrub sder phebs dus me tog kha bye bas// sa gzhi'i khyon kun yongs su gang bar gzigs// rtogs ldan rnams la rtogs pa 'char ba'i rtags// mngon sum gzigs pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// spangs zungs gzhis khar shrī dbang rat+na'i drung*// ston pa sangs rgyas mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar ba// 'khor dang bcas pa mngon sum nyid du gzigs// rgyal ba'i sras po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// dbu ru ka tshal gtsug lag khang chen du// thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong gzigs// gus pa'i thal sbyar gsol ba btab pa las// ting 'dzin chen pos snying rje'i gter kha phye// zhi ba'i phrin las brnyes la phyag 'tshal lo// gnas mchog khra ba kha yi dben gnas su// sngags dang mtshan nyid lha tshogs mang po gzigs// de rnams kun gyis dngos grub sna re gnang*// rje btsun grub pa'i gter la gsol ba 'debs// mtshe'u kha bde ldan gtsug lag khang chen du// nyid kyi mchan khung g.yas g.yon gnyis su ni// bya rog snum zhing yid 'ong 'od 'bar ba// nyid la 'dud pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs par gzigs// gdod ma'i mgon po gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo// slar yang gzims khang thog kha gser khang du// ye shes mgon po gtso 'khor rgyas par gzigs// sku mdog ser po btso ma'i gser lta bu// mngon sum nyid du gsal bar mkha' la snang*// rgyas pa'i phrin las grub la gsol ba 'debs// ti sgro brag dkar tshogs khang chen mo ru// mtsho skyes rdo rje'i tshe sgrub mdzad pa las// slob dpon pad+ma mngon sum nyid du gzigs// thugs phreng bstan nas sku tshe byin gyis brlabs// byin rlabs snang ba'i khyad par bsam mi khyab// gu ru'i gsung sprul khyod la gsol ba 'debs// ja pa'i gdong la phebs dus nad sna yis// 'jigs pa chen pos 'khor rnams skrag pa'i tshe// a phyi mngon sum byon nas dbugs dbyung mdzad// mkha' 'gro'i sras po khyod la gsol ba 'debs// rnying mar gu ru'i rtsa gsum dril sgrub mdzad// gu ru drag pos dngos su zhal bstan nas// lcags kyu zhags pa phreng ba brgya rtsa gnang*// dbang gi phrin las grub la gsol ba 'debs// a phyi sna nam chos kyi sgrol ma ni// mnga' bdag rgyal mo'i gzugs dang chibs zhon ma// mngon sum gzigs nas dgra dpung zlog par mdzad// phrin las mthar phyin mdzad la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar zhal gzigs cung tsam smos pa la// gsang ba 'chol ba'i skyon du gyur pa dang*// 'gal dang ma 'brel la sogs ci mchis pa// mkha' 'gro chos skyong bzod par mdzad du gsol// zhes pa 'di rje rin po che'i gsang ba dang shin du gsang ba'i rnam thar gyi don la dad pa'i spu long g.yos te mig chu dang ldan pas gsol ba btab pa'o// 'dir bdag cag gi bla ma ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i sems can thams cad kyi mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen dam par gyur pa/

'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po rin po che zhes snyan pa'i ba dan dkar po sa gsum du g.yo ba de'i rnam par snang ba mdzad pa'i tshe/ mkhyen gnyis kyi chu gter chen pos 'gro kun srid pa'i rgya mtsho las sgrol bar byed pa'i rten gcig pu ba/ mi mjed kyi zhing 'dir sngon chad ma byung zhing phyis kyang 'byung bar mi 'gyur ba'i rten gyi mchog ye shes kyi rnam par rol pa chen po'i mdangs bkra zhing*/ sku lnga'i zer 'phro ba mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams kun tu bkram par mdzad de/ lus can thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god par bya ba'i phyir/ bkra shis sgo mang yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i dga' ston 'gyed par bzhed nas/ cung zad thugs mnyam par bzhag pa'i tshul gyis nam mkha'i mthar thug par snang ba chen pos khyab par mdzad cing*/ de nyid slar 'dus te nyid kyi sku la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas mdzod spu'i gnas su thim par gyur zhes grags so// de'i tshe sgam po gdar gyi ri la bzhugs pa'i dus mngon sum du/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyi yum rdo rje rnal 'byor mas pho brang tsā ri'i ri bo dag pa shel ri zhes bya ba'i ngos la/ ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i zhing gi bkod pa rab 'byams bkram zhing de dag gi don ma tshang ba med cing lhun gyis grub par bstan nas/ longs sprul zhi khro rab 'byams kyi 'khor lo tha mal pa rnams kyis kyang mngon sum du mjal bar nus pa'i me long*/ rten mchog bkra shis kyi sgo mang 'di nyid ji lta bar gzigs snang gi gtan la phab nas/ slar 'bri gung byang chub kyi gling du kha lo bsgyur zhing*/ sprul pa'i lha bzo ma ṇi bha dra 'khor dang bcas pa 'bod par mdzad nas/ rgyu yi khyad par lha dang mi'i rin po che mtha' dag gis bang mdzod kha phye nas/ 'og tu rin po che'i sa gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lte bar lhun sdug cing byin chags pa'i mchod sdong chen po bang rim du ma dang ldan pa'i rtse mor bka' brgyud kyi bla ma rnams bkra bar mdzad pa nas logs zur rnams la longs sprul zhi khro rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor ma lus pa bkra bar mdzad pa'i lha grangs nyis stong dang brgyad brgya/

steng du gser gdugs dga' ba 'khyil yang rtser gser thog gser 'phru gser bya dang bcas pas kun nas mdzes par mdzad do// 'gro kun tshogs gnyis gsog pa'i rten du 'bri gung 'og min gyi gnas 'dir bzhugs par mdzad/ de la dpe blangs pa'i gdung rgyud na rim gyis kyang mang du bzhengs pa da lta'i bar du yang rgyun ma chad par byung zhing*/ de rnams thams cad las rgya che zhing spangs mtho la rgyu'i khyad par yang shin tu bzang zhing rgya che ba dang bcas pa 'di nyid/ slar yang 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po gdul bya'i me long la 'char bar mdzad pa kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po 'dis/ 'gro ba ma lus pa rnams rnam grol gyi lam la 'god pa dang*/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i bka' drin bsab pa'i phyir bzhengs pa'i dgongs pa shar nas/ thog mar lha'i bzo bo bi shwa karma'i lag rtsal 'gran par nus pa/ deng sang rgya dkar nag bal bod sogs thams cad du bzo rigs la 'gran pa'i zla thams cad dang bral ba dpon mo che rdo rje zhes bya ba/ rgyal ba'i dbang po karma pa'i lha bzo chen po de nyid kyi sprul par yang yongs su grags pa dpon g.yog sum bcu tham pa/ slob dpon pad+mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i sras lung jo bo be ga bzhugs shing byin gyis brlabs pa'i yul chen po rig byed dang nye ba'i rig byed la mkhas pa'i skyes bu du mas gang ba'i sa phyogs byar zhes bya ba nas 'gugs par mdzad de/ dmar ser can zhes bya ba me mo sbrul gyi lo zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bcu gcig gi nyin gza' skar sbyor byed bzang po dang ldan par/ mtshungs med chos kyi rje rin po che nyid kyi phyag phyir lha bzo ba rnams khrid de thig tshad len par phebs pa'i nyin/ nam mkha'i khams thams cad 'od kyi gur khang chen po'i nang du me tog gi char chen po dri ngad dang ldan pa bab cing*/ mtshe'u kha bde ldan gyi gtsug lag khang dang*/

sgo mang gi bar 'ja' tshon gyi bar legs par sbrel te/ ri bo'i ngos kun kyang tshon ris shin tu bkra ba'i 'ja' tshon gyis yol ba bris pa ltar gyur pa sogs ngo mtshar zhing bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan du mas skye dgu rnams kyi yid 'phrog par mdzad nas/ phyag tshad rnams legs par blangs te/ bka' brgyud bla ma'i bang rim legs par spar zhing grub chen brgyad cu nas chos skyong ba'i srung ma chen po gter mgon gyi bar lha grangs sum rgya dang lnga bcu rtsa gcig 'phar ba'i zhal bkod kyi khyad par rnams kyang legs par mdzad de zla ba de nyid kyi nyer gcig la lha khang chen mor bzo thab btsugs zhing*/ nyer gnyis kyi nyin par bzo rigs pa thams cad la byin gyis brlabs pa chen pos byin gyis rlob par mdzad de/ de'i dus thams cad du 'ja' 'od kyi gur nyin mtshan thams cad du phub cing me tog gi char chen po yang bab/ than pa'i dus yin pa la beng lcam dral gyis dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur mngon sum du bstan cing char gyis rgyun chen po yang bab bo// de ltar rgyu'i rab tu gnas pa mdzad pa'i tshe yang ltas dang cho 'phrul bzang po 'brug gi sgra chen po yang dus las ma yol bar grags pa'i ltas bzang po rnams kyi bskul ba ltar bzo rigs pa rnams kyi sems la dad pa'i me tog gsar pa 'khrungs par gyur cing*/ nyin mtshan g.yel ba med par bzo'i khyad par la spro ba dang ldan pas 'grus shing yid gzhung par gyur nas rje nyid kyi dgongs pa sgrub pa la phan tshun 'gran pa ltar gyur pas/ thams cad kyi yid 'phrog par mdzad de/ de'i dus nas rig byed pa rnams la zhabs tog dang bsnyen bkur gyi khyad par dus bzhi dang bstun pa'i sgo nas/ de yi bza' ba dang bca' ba myang ba mang pos yul mi gcig pa'i lugs kyi bye brag rang rang gis yid la ji ltar 'bab pa rnams phongs pa med par mdzad/ gos dang mal stan sogs kyang dbyar dgun gyis 'gyur ba dang bstun nas bu gcig pa la ma ltar brtse zhing byams pas skyo ba dang ngal ba med par sgrub par mdzad/

re re bzhin du yang gang dgos kyi bran g.yog rnams kyang thogs pa med par bskos nas rang rang gang la ci dgos kyi 'dod yon stabs pas rang gi yul yang brjed pa ltar 'gyur ba de ltar bsgrubs shing*/ zla ba re re bzhin du/ dus ston gyis khyad par bzang po dang*/ de'i gnang sbyin ja dang gos dar rta dang dre'u gser dngul la sogs pas rang rang gi yid kyi shing rta gang bar skye bo phal mo ches mthong na blor mi shong ba dang*/ lhag par dus chen rnams la nyid kyi rigs dang chos las 'khrungs pa'i skyes mchog dam pa mi'i seng ge khang gsar nang so'i sde srid kyi khur bzung nas/ nyid kyis zhabs rim sgrub pa'i gtso bo byams pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po bas thog drangs/ khang gsar nang so'i dpon che chung gnyer las 'dzin dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ rin po che'i thog drangs dpon mo che pa rnams la/ ston mo'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bsnyen bkur ba'i steng du/ ka ru ma'i bye brag bzang zhing gya nom pa dang*/ bu chen dang slob ma drung 'khor longs spyod chen po dang ldan pa rnams dang yul gru so sor bskos pa'i dpon che chung byang bod kyi sde dgon dang bcas pa rnams kyi khur blangs pa'i longs spyod rnam thos bu'i dpal la 'gran par nus pa'i dpal 'byor chen pos ka ru ma bzang po dang bcas pa'i sgo nas rig byed pa rnams la shin tu gya nom pa'i dngos po bzang zhing rgya che ba'i bsnyen bkur phan tshun 'gran pa ltar byas so// 'di lta bu'i rten bzhengs kyi grags pa'i dri bzhon gyis sa 'og dang sa steng sa bla thams cad du bkram pa ltar gyur pas/ rgya nag nas gong ma rgyal po'i gnang sbyin gyis thog drangs bsam blo nang so sngo phur kha brgyad sogs rgya nag gi phyogs nas dad thob kyi bu chen rnams kyi rta dang dre'u ja dang gos dar gyi 'bul snod bsam gyis mi khyab pa/

'bul dpon blo gros rgyal mtshan pas thog drangs 'bul dpon rnams kyi phyag tu smin par byas shing*/ 'dan ma'i 'bul dpon kun dga' shes rab dang klu dbang rgya mtsho sogs kyi rta dang dre'u ja dang gos dar gser dngul la sogs pa'i 'bul snod kyi bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab cing rmad du byung ba dang*/ mnga' ris bskor gsum nas rgyal po rnams kyis thog drangs rdor 'dzin so so'i bla ma chen po grwa bu slob dang bcas pa rnams kyis kyang so so nas/ gser dngul zangs gsum sman ras kyi dos/ mchod cha'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ 'bul dpon kun dga' shes rab dang byams pa seng ge sogs kyi dad cing gus pa'i sgo nas rin po che'i bang mdzod 'gengs par mdzad do// gzhis ka rin spungs pas thog drangs dbus gtsang gi btsad po phal cher gyis kyang shin tu dad cing dang ba'i sgo nas yo byad mkho dgu'i zhabs tog bsgrubs shing*/ khyad par spyan snga rin po che chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po'i gnang sbyin gyi thog drangs/ chos kyi rje stag lung pa khu dbon sogs dbus gtsang gi bla ma che dgu phal cher gyis so so nas kyang longs spyod kyi rgyun char ltar phab bo// gzhan yang dwags lha sgam po'i chos rje dang*/ spu bo'i chos rje sogs lho phyogs kyi bla ma che chung grwa bu slob dang bcas pas kyang khur chen po blangs te rang rang gi yul du lha'i cha rkyen du 'gro ba'i dngos po mkho dgu rnams thogs pa med par phul zhing*/ kong po'i phyogs kyi grwa pa yon bdag dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ dwags po'i phyogs kyi sde dpon sku rab pa 'khor bcas/ gzhan yang*/ gnas chen tsā rir bzhugs pa'i rdor 'dzin gyi thog drangs las tshan bco brgyad kyi 'bul snod bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ nyang po dang nye bo rngod dang khams ri bo che sogs nas kyang gser dngul sogs mkho dgu'i yo byad 'bab chu chen po'i rgyun ltar zad mi shes pas dam pa 'di'i dgongs pa mthar phyin pa'i mthun rkyen rnams dad cing dang ba'i sgo nas lhur blangs pa sogs 'di rnams tshad med pa'i thugs rje chen po'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam par rol pa chen po'o// dam pa 'di thugs rje bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas yin pas sngon chad sangs rgyas kyi phrin las ma zhugs shing gdul bya'i gnas su ma gyur pa'i nag po'i hor rnams kyis kyang*/

spyi dgos bye brag so so nas dad cing dang ba'i shugs drag po la brten te/ rje nyid dang rten bkra shis sgo mang gi grags pa chen pos yid mgu bar gyur nas thams cad kyi dngos po'i khyad par bzang zhing rgya che ba phul nas/ de rnams la yang thar pa'i sa bon thebs pa ni rmad du byung ba las kyang ches rmad du byung pa'i mdzad pa'o// de nas thog mar bzo phud du mnyam med dwags po bka' brgyud ces grags pa'i 'od zer gyi phreng bas nam mkha'i mthar thug pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag gis mun pa sel ba'i gzhir gyur pa'i bla ma/ ting 'dzin rgyal po sogs mdo rgyud du ma nas lung bstan pa'i skyes mchog dam pa mi'i seng ge mnyam med dwags po rin po che la/ rje 'di nyid mi phyed pa'i dad pa brtan po thob cing yang yang zhal mjal zhing gsung gi gnang ba yang dpag tu med pa thob pas/ de'i bka' drin bsab pa'i phyir rgyu bzang zhing zhal bkod kyi khyad par ngo mtshar bar mdzad pa/ dpon mo che pas kyang dad cing gus pas dang du blangs te dbyar chos kyi dus su legs par grub cing nang bzhugs mdo rgyud dang mthun par mdzad/ de'i rab tu gnas pa yang dri ma med pa'i mdo sde dang rgyud sde rin po che las ji ltar byung ba'i cho ga'i rim pa ma nor zhing ma 'khrugs pa phyag len rnam par dag pa/ rje nyid kyis thog drangs dge slong gi dge 'dun snam sbyar thogs pa brgya phrag longs pas rab tu gnas pa spyan dbye mnga' dbul dang bcas pa legs par grub pa'i mthar shis brjod kyi me tog 'thor ba skabs la bab pa'i dus/ gza' skar sbyor byed bzang po dang ldan pa'i snga dro'i cha la dge 'dun gyi tshogs pa rgya mtsho lta bus zhabs rim bsgrubs te me tog 'thor ba'i tshe/ lha rnams kyis nam mkha'i khams me tog gi char chen pos gang bar byas shing*/ bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan du ma dang bcas te legs par grub/ de nyid dang rjes su 'brel bar 'og gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje dang rin po che'i sa gzhi nas nyi zla bya ru'i bar gyi mchod sdong chen po'i ma khog gi skye mched dang 'phrul las grub pa'i lha rnams legs par bsgrubs shing*/

de nas lugs ma'i gtso bo nyi zla bya ru dang bcas pa la bzhugs pa'i/ chos rje bla ma'i dngul sku chen mo dngul srang sum cu las legs par grub pa phyag tshad skye mched sogs de'i khri rgyab yol zangs gser las grub pa/ bkra shis pa'i khri drug 'gyogs/ rgyan rnam bzhi dang bcas pa dpon mo che pas bzo gnye bzung tsam ma gtogs rang byon gyis tshul tu byung bas/ dpon mo che pa yang shin tu ngo mtshar te dad pa'i spu long rab tu g.yos shing legs par grub pa'i nang bzhugs rab gnas mnga' dbul shis brjod sogs snga ma ltar rje rin po che nyid kyis thog drangs dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po snam sbyar gyi rgyal mtshan thogs pa grangs rab tu mang po dang bcas pa'i dge 'dun gyi tshogs pa rgya mtsho lta bus shis brjod kyi me tog 'thor ba'i tshe/ dngul sku chen mo las 'od zer kha dog sna lnga phyogs thams cad tu 'phro ba kun gyis mthun snang du grub cing me tog gi char dang 'ja' 'od kyi gur la sogs pas skye dgu thams cad kyi yid 'phrog par mdzad cing thams cad dad pa'i chu mtsho chen pos gang bar gyur to// de nas lha rnams rim pa ltar ji ltar grub grub nas nang bzhugs kyi khyad par dang rab tu gnas pa yang 'phral 'phral grub par mdzad cing*/ chos skyong bang rim gyi rgyal chen bzhi grub par nye ba'i dus su/ 'ol kha stag gsher sogs mi srun pa'i skye bo sde srid la bsdo ba ltar snang ba'i phas rgol thams cad tshar bcad cing dbang du bsdus pa yin no// de dang mtshungs ldan du 'bri gung pa'i sde srid la shin tu gnod par gyur pa'i dgra bo bsgral ba'i zhing bcu tshang ba'i dga' ldan a bsod ces bya ba'i mgo dang glo snying ye shes kyi mgon pos khyer nas mgon khang du byung ba dam pa 'dis mngon sum du gzigs nas zhal ta'i rnam pa zar zur byon pa la/ la la dag gis thugs kyi zhe 'dod yin las che zer zhing 'phyas btags byas pa las/

dmag sgar de nyid ma zhig par 'bri gung pa'i steng du 'ongs pa snye thang du sleb pa na/ rang gi g.yog pos snying bton te bsgral bas thams cad kyi mngon sum du rtsod pa med par gyur to// de ltar na bkra shis sgo mang gi phyi mo la lha nyis stong brgyad brgyar grags pa las/ bka' brgyud bla ma'i bang rim la grub thob brgyad cu'i grangs ldan dang gzhan yang rje nyid mos pa'i grub chen 'ga' zhig dang rje nyid kyis bka' drin mnos pa'i bla ma gnyis kyi lhag pa'i bcu phrag rje nyer gnyis rin po che phyin chod kyi gdung rgyud rin po che dad thob kyi sku rnams nas sngar smos pa ltar gter mgon gyi bar du lha sum brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa gcig 'phar bar bgrangs pa'i sum stong dang brgya lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi grangs dang ldan pa rnams la so so'i nang bzhugs kyi rim pa/ bla ma dang grub chen gong ma rnams kyis gdung ring bsrel dbu skra phyag sen phyag phreng byin rlabs can rnams dang gzhan yang sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi gdung ring bsrel rtsod pa med pa dang*/ lha che ba rnams la gzungs kyi bye brag tshang ma nyis 'gyur dang sum 'gyur/ 'bring po rnams la yang gzungs chen grags che ba rnams dang*/ chung ngu 'phrul ma rnams kyi nang du 'ang rang rang gi gzungs chung gi khyad par rnams lañja dang 'ba' gru sngags kyi rnam pa ji ltar 'os 'os sogs dang*/ tha na gnod sbyin pho mo'i 'khor lo yan chod kyi nang bzhugs kyi rim pa rnams go rim ma 'chol zhing ma 'khrugs la mtshan nyid dang ldan par nyid kyis zhal bkod kyi khyab par mdzad nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnam dpyod dang ldan zhing*/ nyid la dad pa brtan po'i mthu thob pa rnams kyis legs par bsgrubs shing*/ lhag par yang mchod sdong chen mo'i nang bzhugs kyi rim pa las thog mar bka' brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyi gsang mtshan grangs mang mthing shog dri ma med pa'i ngos la 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser gyis bris pa'i pod longs mang po dang*/

rten gsum gyi khyad par sku gzugs dang mchod rten byin rlabs can grags che zhing rtsod pa med pa mang po dang gzungs 'dus dang gzungs 'bum la sogs pa gzungs kyi bye brag tshar mang po dang gsung rab kyi tshogs bzhugs pa bsam gyis mi khyab cing*/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dzhai k+ṣim la sogs pa'i rin po che'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams dang rmad du byung ba'i lha'i bdud rtsi lus sems la bde ba'i dpal ster bar byed pa'i ja dang bu ram hag dang ka ra la du'i dos shin tu mang po dang sman shing shin tu bzang po'i 'bras bu dri dang ro mchog phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i dos mang po dang*/ gzhan yang lha dang mi'i zas sna'i khyad par gya nom pa rnams dang*/ deng phon dang za 'og la sogs pa lha'i gos dri ma med pa'i yug mang po dang*/ gos dang dar gyi khyad par kha dog sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab tu bkra ba mang po dang*/ lha dang mi'i sman gyi khyad par ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i dos mang po dang*/ gzhan yang ka shi ka'i ras la sogs pa nas shin tu bkra shis pa'i na bza'i bye brag mang po dang*/ khyad par yang rje btsun dam pa 'di nyid kyi dbu skra dang phyag sen na bza' dang gzims chas gsol spyad cha tshang sogs mdor na nang bzhugs kyi khyad par mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams las ji ltar bshad pa dang mi 'gal bar mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs par mdzad cing*/ de'i dbu thog tu gser gdugs bkra shis 'khyil pa rgyu bzang zhing 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser gyi gan pa'i ngos la/ 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi gtso bo mdzad pa'i lha grangs bcu phrag gnyis kyi lhag pa'i brgya phrag gi grangs ldan dang*/ de'i steng du sprul pa'i shing mkhan mkhas pa dad pa dang ldan pas legs par bsgrubs pa'i ka ba seng ge dang rdo rjes bteg pa'i shing sgrom rmad du byung ba'i steng du/

g.yu thog gis mdzes par khebs pa'i yang rtser 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser thog gi 'dzar rnams la bkra shis pa'i rtags brgyad/ rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun la sogs pa'i bkod pa 'chang zhing*/ de'i tog gi rtse mor gser 'phru gser bya shin tu mdog sdug cing yid du 'ong la bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan du ma dang ldan pa'i bar rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang gi mdangs 'phrog par byed pa'i gzhal med kyi khang pa chen po dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs par don grub zhes bya ba lcags pho spre'u yi nang du legs par grub pa'i dbu gzhung thon gsum gyis ston mo'i bye brag bzo rigs pa rnams la gnang sbyin gyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad pa'i tshul rnams lha dang mi'i 'jig rten na 'gran zla thams cad dang bral zhing rig byed pa rnams kyang rang rang gi yid kyi chu mtsho dga' ba'i dpal gyis gang bar gyur to// de dag re re'i ming gi rnam grangs ni yi ge mang gi dogs nas 'dir ma bkod do// 'di rnams kyi zhabs rim mkhan slob chos gsum gyis thog drangs 'bri gung byang chub kyi gling du bzhugs pa'i che bgres grwa bu slob sgrub sde grwa nang dang bcas pa rnams kyis kyang longs spyod kyi dngos po'i khyad par dpag tu med pa phul zhing*/ mnyes pa rnam pa gsum gyis mnyes par mdzad pas 'brel tshad don dang ldan par gyur te/ bye brag so so'i rab tu gnas pa rnams rje rin po che 'di nyid thugs rje dang mkhyen rabs rmad du byung bas mnga' dbul shis brjod kyi bar du mtshan nyid dang ldan par grub cing*/ rab gnas chen mo'i gral dbu yang rje rin po che nyid kyis mdzad de/ dge slong gi dge 'dun rnam sbyar gyis rgyal mtshan thogs pa brgya stong mang pos thog drangs te dge 'dun gyi tshogs pa rgya mtsho lta bus gza' skar sbyor byed bzang po la me tog 'thor ba'i dus su lha rnams kyis me tog gi char chen pos nam mkha'i khams yongs su gang bar byas te lding zhing 'bab par gyur/

ri bo'i ngos kun kyang 'ja' tshon gyis drwa bas chod par gyur te/ kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung rgya mtshos legs par mchod pa'i gzhi bzung ste/ dri ma med pa'i mdo sde dang rgyud sde las byung ba'i rab gnas mtshan nyid dang ldan par mdzad pas de'i dus su ye shes sems dpa' mngon sum du zhugs pa'i ltas dang cho 'phrul gyi rnam pa dpag tu med pa dang*/ byin rlabs kyi snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pas der gnas pa'i skye dgu thams cad thar pa'i lam sna zin par gyur cing*/ blo mig dag pa rnams kyi mngon sum du ye shes sems dpa'i tshogs sprin char bzhin du bab nas/ rten bkra shis sgo mang la thim par gyur pa'i mod la/ rten gsum rnams las 'od zer gyis phreng ba brgya stong du ma 'phros zhing 'jig rten gyis khams rab 'byams thams cad snang ba chen pos khyab par mthong ngo*// de'i 'og tu chos bzang lha'i mdun sa'i dpal phun sum tshogs pa'i gzi la 'gong bar nus pa'i gral bkod mdzad nas/ lha dang mi'i bza' ba dang bca' ba'i khyad par rnams kyis bsnyen bkur ba bzang po dang ldan pas bsnyen bkur ba'i steng du/ yon gyi khyad par thog mar dpon mo che pa la/ bcud phun sum tshogs pas gang ba'i gan dkar gyis thog drangs/ bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan du ma dang ldan pa'i gser spyad dang dngul spyad la sogs pa'i gsol spyad kyi skor cha yongs su tshang ba dang*/ dpal gyi be'u la sogs pa'i ri mo'i khyad par dang ldan pa'i kha btags dang*/ deng phon za 'og la sogs pa gos dar gyi yug bzang zhing grangs shin tu mang po dang*/ lu hang bkra shis pa'i ri mo du mas spras pa'i na bza' la sogs pa cha yongs su tshang ba dang*/ 'gros bzang zhing mdog sdug la 'gying dang ldan pa'i chibs dang dre'u rab tu mang po dang*/ gser dngul g.yu dang mu tig la sogs pa lha dang mi'i rin po che'i rnam grangs du ma dang*/

gzhan yang ja bzang po sig grangs mang po dang*/ go khrab bzang spyad mdzo pho mo sogs rkang bzhi'i tshogs kyis sa'i tha gru yongs su bkang ste gnang bar mdzad cing*/ lha bzo'i tshogs thams cad la'ang gsol spyad dang na bza'i tshogs cha yongs su tshang ba dang*/ ja dang gos dar gser g.yu zangs gsum sogs rin po che'i bye brag dpag tu med pa dang*/ mdor na rta dang dre'u go khrab kyi khyad par du mas sa'i ngos kun tu khebs par mdzad cing*/ rkang bzhi'i tshogs rnams kyang bgrang ba las 'das pas rang rang gi bsam pa'i don yid bzhin du grub par gyur te/ rab tu gnas pa dang me tog 'thor bar mdzad pa'i bla ma che dgu rnams la bcud dang ldan pa'i gan dkar gyis thog drangs gsol spyad dang na bza'i khyad par du ma dang ja dang gos dar gser g.yu zangs gsum rta dang dre'u la sogs pa'i gnang sbyin bzang po dang*/ dge 'dun gyi tshogs pa rgya mtsho lta bu la yang*/ gos dang dar gyi chun pos nam mkha' dang bar snang thams cad dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab tu mdzes pas gang bar mdzad cing*/ gzhan yang ras dos dang sman dos rkang bzhi'i tshogs dang bcas pas rnam thos kyi bu'i 'byor pa zil gyis mnan nas gnang sbyin gyi tshogs rnams kyis skye dgu thams cad lugs gnyis kyi 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa la bkod pa 'di yang rmad du byung ba'i mdzad pa rlabs po che nam mkha'i mdzod la dbang 'byor ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyis cho 'phrul bla na med pa'o// de'i dus kyi dga' ston gyi khyad par tshigs su bcad de smras pa// dbang po'i mdun na nye dbang sum cu ltar// chas bzang dpal dang ldan pa'i drung 'khor rnams// lus bzang dpal dang ldan pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan// sna tshogs gos dang dar gyis lhab lhub g.yo// 'gying ldan mgyogs 'gro'i steng nas 'phongs rlabs 'gran// dge 'dun rnams ni rang rang gzhung lugs kyis// chos kyi gtam gyis kun tu dga' bar mdzad// pho brang lha yi na chung bzang mo rnams// sna tshogs rgyan gyi rnam pa du mas spud// snyan pa'i glu len mdzes pa'i gar sgyur ba// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang 'gran pa'i phyir// 'chi med yul nas da lta 'ongs pa bzhin// gser gyi rna rgyan g.yo ba'i khye'u rnams// dri zhim li ba'i lcang lo gyen du 'phyang*// rin chen rgyan dang gos kyi lhab lhub g.yo// 'gro ba'i mig la bdud rtsi ster ba bzhin// de dus phyogs der 'tshogs pa'i skal ldan rnams// dal 'byor don dang ldan pa'i zlos gar bsgyur// nyin dang mtshan mo'i dus rnams thams cad du// skye dgu'i mgon po mtshungs med chos kyi rje// dpal 'byor mtsho ltar rgyas pa'i ngang ny-id nas// srid mtha'i bar du bzhugs pa'i gsol 'debs kyi// dar dir sgrog la ngal ba med par gyur// de yi ngang nas bkra shis rig byed pa// kun la rje 'dis dam chos bdud rtsi yis// char rgyun phab te yongs su smin par mdzad// kun kyang thal sbyar rje la 'dud bzhin du// dad pa'i rlung gis yid kyis klu dbang skul// mig gnyis mi 'dzum chos rje'i zhal la blta// skye dang skye bar khyed kyi zhabs pad dang*// skad cig tsam yang 'bral bar ma gyur zhes// smon lam rgya mtsho'i rgyang glu len bzhin du// rang rang 'dod pa'i gnas su chas pa dang*// de tshe kun gyi skyel ma'i khyad par gyis// lha dang mi yi yid rab 'phrog par byas// rang yul yid bzhin rgya mtshor phyin gyis bar// ngal dang dub pa med pa'i lam la zhugs// dpal dang ldan pa'i nor dang lhan cig tu// rang yul 'byor pa'i tshogs kyis gang bar byas// gnyen bshes tshogs rnams dbul zhing phongs pa yi// 'jigs med longs spyod dpal dang ldan par gyur// de nas mtshungs med chos rje rin chen 'di// tshogs gnyis rgya mtshos dgongs pa gang gyur nas// skye dgu ma lus skyob pa'i phrin las mdzad// lha mi'i rin chen ma lus spungs pa'i ri// rgyal ba sras bcas bzhugs pa'i zhing khams mchog

/yi dam dkyil 'khor lha yi gzhal med khang*// zhi khro rab 'byams 'tshogs pa'i grong khyer che// lha phrug me tog 'thor ba'i gnas bzang yul// 'gro kun tshogs gnyis gsog pa'i rten gcig po// stong gsum mi mjed zhing gi dpal gyur pa// 'gro kun 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po las// sgrol ba'i gru chen bkra shis sgo mang 'di// yang yang gzigs pas ngoms pa med par gyur// skad cig yengs med mchod pa'i las la brtson// 'di nyid sgrub pa'i khur gyis gtso bo ni// mgon po'i mtshan gyis rgyal mtshan 'dzin mkhas pa// bzang po'i dpal dang ldan pas gtso bo byas// rgyu skar tshogs ltar dar ba'i drung 'khor rnams// rje la gus pa'i chu mtsho ma bri zhing*// nyin mtshan ngal ba med pa'i brtul zhugs kyis// zhabs rim bsgrubs nas mtha' ru 'don par mdzad// gser zangs rgyu yi khyad par phal cher gyi// las gnyer do dam mtshams sbyor khur len pa// kun dga' shes rab zhes bya'i gus ldan gyis// legs par bsgrubs shing dal 'byor don ldan byas// 'di yi phyogs su longs spyod btang ba yi// rta dang glang po rin chen gser dngul nas// tha na khab dang skud pa yan chod du// cung zad tsam gyi 'byor ba phul ba dang*// 'di yi phyogs su rgyu lus bskol ba yi// tsha grang ngal dub khyad du bsad nas ni// nyin mtshan g.yel med bya ba bsgrub pa nas// tha na chu len me 'bud yan chad kyi// brtson pa lhur blangs gang yin thams cad dang*// khyad par khro 'am dad pa'i sems byung ba// de dag kun kyang byang chub mchog thob par// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas gsungs pa'i phyir// 'di 'dra'i mgon gyis rjes su bzung ba yi// skye dgu rnams ni dal 'byor snying po len// de phyir dga' bar gyis la gsol ba thob// zhes so// de ltar 'gran pa'i zla thams cad dang bral ba'i bdag cag gi bla ma dam pa rigs rus dang cho 'brang gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi yon tan thams cad kyi rtse mor son zhing*/

'gro kun srid pa'i rgya mtsho las bsgral bar byed pa'i ded dpon chen po 'dis/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum las gus pa rlabs po che'i sgo nas srid zhu'i rim pa/ bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur rab 'byams lha'i 'khor lo ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i sku gzugs kyi bye brag bkra shis sgo mang don gnyis kyi dngos grub stsol ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che 'di nyid bzhengs shing*/ phrin las rnam pa bzhi la dbang bsgyur ba'i tshul cung zad smos te/ bu chen dang slob ma'i tshogs sngar 'dus pa'i gtso bo tsam gong du smos pa ltar yin/ deng sang 'dus pa'i gtso che ba 'ga' zhig tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ jo gdan mkhan chen kun dga' dpal 'byor ba// gling gi du si ting 'dzin 'od zer dang*// chos sgo'i khur 'dzin ngag gi dbang po dang*// gangs dkar ras chen zhes bya'i skyes mchog dang*// khra ba kha yi gdan sa'i khur 'dzin che// bsod nams rgya mtsho zhes bya'i mkhas grub dang*// 'chad ka spyan snga bya yul spyan snga dang*// rab 'byams gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i mthar son pa// rdo rje rgyal mtshan zhes bya'i bshes gnyen dang*// mtshungs med grub chen don grub rnam rgyal gyi// sku skye kun dga' rgya mtsho zhes bya dang*// rwa sgreng mthu chen zhes bya'i gdung rigs las// legs 'ongs kun dga' rgya mtsho'i mtshan 'chang dang*// smon lam dpal zhes bya ba'i bshes gnyen dang*// zur mang chos rje kun spangs chen po dang*// stag lung pa yi mkhan slob chos gsum dang*// dpal ldan 'brug pa'i chos rje rin chen dang*/ gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i rdor 'dzin bskos pa ni// ti se rdor 'dzin mgon po ye shes dang*// dpal ldan blo gros zhes bya'i rdor 'dzin dang*// la phyi rdor 'dzin blo gros dpal ldan dang*// rdor 'dzin kun dga' rdo rje zhes bya dang*// tsā ri'i rdor 'dzin bsod nams rgyal mtshan sogs// rdor 'dzin chen po bstan pa'i rtsa lag gang*// mang du bskos shing sprul pa'i skyes mchog rnams// bstan pa rin chen gsal ba'i sgron mer mdzad// gzhan du che ba'i bu chen slob ma ni/

tha na rgya yi 'khor sa yan chad du// dbus gtsang khams gsum che btsun thams cad kyis// zhabs la gtugs shing the tshom sgro 'dogs gcad// dus 'dir bstan pa'i bdag por gyur pas na// bu chen slob ma re re'i ming nas ni// yi ge'i 'du byed bsgyur bar gang gis nus// cung zad cha tsam smos pa de ltar yin// dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i rnam par thar pa dad ldan thar pa'i 'jug ngogs las/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la srid zhus mnyes par mdzad cing*/ phrin las bzhi la dbang bsgyur ba'i le'u ste drug pa'o// ༈ //chos rje'i rnam thar yid bzhin rgya mtsho las// skra rtse'i chu thigs tsam zhig blangs pa 'di// bdag blo dman pa'i spyod yul ma yin yang*// dam pa 'di la dad pa'i mthu thob cing*// bslab gsum rin chen rgyan gyis legs mdzes shing*// rim gnyis rtse mor phyin pa'i skyes bu mchog /puṇ+ya sa mu dra yi mtshan 'chang dang*// nyid kyi thugs las skyes pa'i sras kyi mchog /bya ba kun la thogs med spobs pa can// blon po rin chen lta bu'i tshul 'chang ba// 'gro ba'i mgon po 'bri gung rin chen gyi// dgongs pa sgrub phyir sde srid rgyal mtshan ni// 'khor yug ri bo'i bar du 'dzin mkhas pa// dpal ldan bzang po'i gsung gis bskul ba'i ngor// mtshungs med chos rjes legs par bskyangs pa'i bu// gzhung brgya 'byed la thogs med spobs pa can// spong ba'i brtul zhugs la gnas dben gsum pa// rat+na'i ming can bdag gis bsgrubs pa'o// 'di yi yi ge'i 'du byed bsgyur ba ni// yig bris rgya mtsho'i pha rol mthar son pa// rin chen bsam 'phel zhes byas legs par bsgrubs// de las
